features.description: Two cluster-lifecycle fixes for run-scenario.sh + cluster-up.sh: (1) Pin the scenario workflow to the newly created chart-test-swarm-<id> context. cluster-up.sh must NOT restore the caller's previous context on EXIT until the full scenario lifecycle is done; OR pass explicit `--context $CLUSTER_NAME` to every kubectl/helm invocation inside apply-scenario.sh/run-scenario.sh so it never depends on global current-context. The kubeconfig restore must happen at the very end (after cluster-down) so a long-running scenario does not race the caller's kubectl. (2) Clarify KEEP_CLUSTER semantics: KEEP_CLUSTER=1 (default) means 'keep on success'. On failure or SIGINT/SIGTERM, the cluster MUST be torn down regardless of KEEP_CLUSTER unless KEEP_ON_FAILURE=1 is set (new explicit override for debug). Update bats tests for both behaviors.

Failure path: any non-zero exit from a step tears down the cluster (unless KEEP_ON_FAILURE=1 is explicitly set)
SIGINT/SIGTERM path: trap writes INTERRUPTED status and tears down the cluster regardless of KEEP_CLUSTER
Success path with default KEEP_CLUSTER=1: cluster is kept
